title_en: The Man Who Saw Cats in Human Faces
title_zh: 从人的脸上看到猫的人

paragraphs.en: Imagine feline forms haunting every human face you encounter as you go about your day. Seeing these Cheshire cats flickering into view, you might think you had tumbled down the rabbit hole. It seems phantasmagorical. But this is the experience of a 28-year-old man named Karl who lives in the northeastern United States.
paragraphs.zh: 想象一下，在你日常生活中遇到的每一张人脸上，都萦绕着猫的形态。看着这些柴郡猫般的面孔闪现眼前，你或许会以为自己掉进了兔子洞。这听起来像是幻境。但这正是居住在美国东北部的28岁男子卡尔（Karl）的亲身经历。

paragraphs.en: When Karl wakes in the morning, his gray tabby Luna is often the first being he greets, and Luna’s face, the first he gazes upon: the whiskers, the almond eyes, the pink nose, the stripes. When this happens, the image of Luna’s face sticks with him for several hours or even the rest of his day. He sees his feline companion’s eyes and silver stripes superimposed over all of the human faces that he glimpses, both in person and online.
paragraphs.zh: 卡尔早晨醒来时，常常第一眼看到的就是他的灰色虎斑猫卢娜（Luna），而卢娜的脸也是他最先凝视的：胡须、杏仁眼、粉色的鼻子、条纹。每当这时，卢娜的脸庞影像会在他脑海中停留数小时，甚至一整天。无论是当面见到的人，还是在网上看到的人脸，他都会看到这位猫伙伴的眼睛和银色条纹叠加其上。

paragraphs.en: The reverse is also true: If the first face he sees in the morning is a human one, he will see that person’s pupils and eye shape superimposed on every other face he sees that day, including the furry mug of his pet cat. These superpositions are seamless: The faces otherwise appear normal and coherent.
paragraphs.zh: 反过来也一样：如果他早上第一眼看到的是人脸，那么当天他看到的每一张脸——包括他宠物猫毛茸茸的脸——都会叠加那个人的瞳孔和眼型。这些叠加毫无缝隙：除此之外，人脸看起来正常且连贯。

paragraphs.en: Karl’s visions began after he had brain surgery to remove some abnormally connected blood vessels from his right posterior temporal lobe, the command center for recognizing a person’s identity and reading their facial expressions. These visions, and more run-of-the-mill face distortions, where faces simply don't look right, have plagued Karl for two years post-surgery. He appears to have developed a combination of two rare neurological conditions: palinopsia, where an image persists in someone’s field of vision after exposure, and prosopometamorphopsia, where a person sees distorted faces.
paragraphs.zh: 卡尔的幻视始于一次脑部手术，手术切除了他右侧颞后叶中一些异常连接的血管，该区域是识别个人身份和解读面部表情的控制中心。术后两年来，这些幻视以及更常见的面部扭曲——即人脸看起来就是不对劲——一直困扰着卡尔。他似乎同时患上了两种罕见的神经系统疾病：视像残留（palinopsia），即图像在视野中停留不去；以及面孔变形症（prosopometamorphopsia），即患者看到扭曲的面孔。

paragraphs.en: Brad Duchaine, a professor and psychologist at Dartmouth University, heard about Karl through Jennifer Nosker, a neuropsychologist at Brigham and Women’s Hospital who worked with Karl after his surgery. When Karl told Nosker about his face distortions, she found Duchaine’s work on the subject, and contacted him. At Dartmouth’s Social Perception Lab, Duchaine has been studying prosopometamorphopsia for many years, collecting accounts through a website dedicated to the condition. Over the past five years, around 275 individuals have contacted the lab through the site .
paragraphs.zh: 达特茅斯大学（Dartmouth University）教授兼心理学家布拉德·杜沙因（Brad Duchaine）通过珍妮弗·诺斯克（Jennifer Nosker）得知了卡尔的情况。诺斯克是布莱根妇女医院（Brigham and Women’s Hospital）的神经心理学家，在卡尔术后曾与他共事。当卡尔向诺斯克描述自己的面部扭曲时，她找到了杜沙因关于该课题的研究，并联系了他。在达特茅斯的社会感知实验室，杜沙因多年来一直研究面孔变形症，并通过一个专门网站收集病例。过去五年中，约有275人通过该网站联系了实验室。

paragraphs.en: “Karl finds the transfers between cat and human faces very strange,” writes Duchaine, in an email. “He has had problems with face perception for some time, though, so he has adapted to them and takes them in stride.” All of his distortions began after his surgery, Duchaine explains.
paragraphs.zh: “卡尔觉得猫脸和人脸之间的转换非常奇怪，”杜沙因在电子邮件中写道，“不过，他出现面部感知问题已有一段时间，所以他已经适应了，并能从容应对。”杜沙因解释说，他所有的扭曲现象都始于手术之后。

paragraphs.en: Ordinarily, people with prosopometamorphopsia see alterations in the shape or position of facial features or in the color or texture of skin. For example, some people with the condition see eyes and mouths stretched into “demonic” shapes, with grooves in the forehead, or they might see features drooping, swelling or twisting. Face substitutions are an atypical expression of this unusual condition.
paragraphs.zh: 通常，面孔变形症患者会看到面部特征的形状或位置发生变化，或者皮肤颜色或质地出现改变。例如，有些患者会看到眼睛和嘴巴被拉伸成“恶魔般的”形状，额头出现沟壑，或者看到五官下垂、肿胀或扭曲。面孔替换则是这种罕见病症的一种非典型表现。
